what: When a sticker is 25% in view it pops on from .6x scale and rotateX −25° (bottom edge axis) over .9s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275) (opacity .8s). On hover the top edge folds 25% (45% when pressed) and a faded back side comes down (.6s ease-out), and on drag it tilts ×.4 (±20°) of the horizontal movement in .15s power1.out, following along and sliding with inertia. On release it stands upright in .6s power2.out. It cannot leave the parent board

options.tilt: Tilt per dragged horizontal px (deg), default .4
options.back: Duration to stand up right after release (s), default .6
options.bounds: Draggable area — selector, none means unrestricted. Default is the parent element
options.[data-fx-part=art]: Sticker graphic (required) — svg·img. The back side clones and flips it
options.--fx-pad·--fx-peel·--fx-peel-press: Peel allowance (10px) · fold on hover (25%) · fold on press (45%)

note: With InertiaPlugin loaded it glides after release (without it, it stops where it is). On touch devices no drag is attached, only the sticking motion — stickers span the screen, so a finger swipe must scroll the page (the original drags on touch too). The shadow is attached to art by the user
